BiblicalUsage: Abinoam is the father of Barak, named in Deborah's call to battle and in her song of victory: 'Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men... Barak the son of Abinoam?' He is known only as a father, in the story of his son's victory.
TheologicalSignificance: A father named only because his son answered God's call — and that is enough. I believe Abinoam's three verses honour the fathers behind the fighters: Barak goes to Tabor, Deborah sings, and the name of the father who raised him is written into the song.
